faq.question: What is the H-1B wage level for Data Scientists in Philadelphia, PA?
faq.answer: Under the OEWS prevailing wage system, the four wage levels for Data Scientists in Philadelphia, PA are: Level I $73,944, Level II $96,012, Level III $118,081, and Level IV $140,150. Your H-1B registration wage level is determined by which threshold your guaranteed wage meets or exceeds.

faq.question: What are the H-1B lottery odds for Data Scientists in Philadelphia, PA?
faq.answer: Under the DHS weighted selection model for FY2027, baseline probabilities are: Level I 15.29% (1 entry), Level II 30.58% (2 entries), Level III 45.87% (3 entries), Level IV 61.16% (4 entries). Actual outcomes depend on total registration volume and wage-level distribution.

faq.question: When is the FY2027 H-1B registration window?
faq.answer: The USCIS FY2027 H-1B cap registration window opens March 4, 2026 (12:00 PM ET) and closes March 19, 2026 (12:00 PM ET).
